target.name: Kayne Anderson Energy Total Return Fund, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: the proposed merger of Kayne Anderson Energy Total Return Fund, Inc. (NYSE: KYE) with and into Kayne Anderson Midstream/Energy Fund, Inc. (NYSE: KMF)

announcement.quote: Kayne Anderson Energy Total Return Fund (KYE) to merge with and into Kayne Anderson Midstream/Energy Fund (KMF) in a non-taxable transaction (the “Merger”)

deals.notes: Filings through 2018-06-01 only propose the merger (later renamed the Reorganization). The 2019-05-23 DEF 14A excerpt is a combined annual-meeting proxy for KYN and KMF and says nothing about KYE or the outcome.
